args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and FIN-212
require banker's rounding. Update the rounding mode so half-cent values
round to the nearest even cent, fixing test_money.py.

args.body:
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` (despite its docstring claiming otherwise).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).

## Verification
- CI run on branch commit 08d3cd5986 passed (all tests green).
